observations: The film's cool left plaster, warm right plaster, stains and the angular light boundary beside the arched window are represented more closely than in v27.
The oblique rendering retains the full wall thickness, open windows, window recesses, room depth and courtyard curvature. The color projection remains attached to those physical surfaces.
No foreground door or character silhouette was observed painted onto the facade in the reviewed views.

Some cornice edges are conspicuously bright, and unobserved facade areas still have visible brightness transitions. This appearance treatment retains reference illumination rather than recovering measured albedo.
The window frame and projection alignment remains imperfect in places. The glass and original room materials were intentionally excluded from the treatment.
remaining: 水面倒影过于清晰，缺少电影参照里的柔和反射、可见水底、藻类与亮点；下一步优先校准反射/透射比例和粗糙度。
门内灰色横带云层仍需重建为空间夜云，夜间花草、山地与天空色彩尚未匹配。
实体墙面已加入固定参照色彩，但部分檐口偏亮，遮挡区、未观察到的区域和侧面仍有明暗接缝，个别窗边投影存在错位。
人物左手、腰线、右裙摆与握门动作仍有投影偏差；脸型、发丝及门基砖石需继续精修，并保留脚部间隙与跨门连续性。
岸台、后方管线、屋顶和钢架的隐藏部分仍含推定；另一幅关门海报场景尚未完成一比一核对。
网页选面、固定坐标材质插入、脚本和资源均已检查；浏览器页面连接仍超时，实际 WebGL 显示和旋转交互尚未验证。

nextWaterInvestigation.note: Read from the legacy builder and its palette; inspect the actual saved v28 material node inputs before choosing a new trial. No water edit was performed in v28.
